entries.def:
εἰκῇ (-ῆ, Rec., as in cl.), adv., 
[in LXX: Pro.28.25 (εἰκῇ)* ;] 
__1. without cause or reason: Mat.5.22 (E, mg.), Col.2.18 (ICC). 
__2. vainly, fruitlessly, to no purpose: Rom.13.4, 1Co.15.2, Gal.3.4; 4.11, Col.2.18.
† (AS)

εἴκοσι (never -ιν in WH, cf. Bl., §5, 3, and note), indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά, 
twenty: Luk.14.31, Jhn.6.19, Act.1.15; 27.28, 1Co.10.8, Rev.4.4, 10; 5.8; 11.16; 19.4.†
(AS)

εἴκω, 
[in LXX: 2Sa.12.7 (ענה), Wis.18.25, 4Ma.1.6 * ;] 
to yield: Gal.2.5 (cf. ὑπ-είκω).†
(AS)

εἴκω (obsolete pres.), see: ἔοικα Transcriber note: This form does not occur in Abbott-Smith. It should be on p. 158..
(AS)

εἰκών, -όνος (cf. ἔοικα), 
[in LXX chiefly for צֶלֶם ;] 
an image, likeness: Mat.22.20, Mrk.12.16, Luk.20.24, Rom.1.23, 1Co.15.49, Rev.13.14, 15; 14.9, 11; 15.2; 16.2; 19.20; 20.4; opposite to σκιά, Heb.10.1 of man, εἰ. θεοῦ, 1Co.11.7; of the regenerate, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ Col.3.10 (see Lft., in l.); εἰ. τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, Rom.8.29, 2Co.3.18; of Christ, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ, 2Co.4.4, Col.1.15.† SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, denoting resemblance,…

εἰλικρινία (Rec., cl., -κρινεία), -ας, ἡ 
(εἰλικρινής), [in LXX: Wis.7.25 A * ;] 
sincerity, purity: 1Co.5.8, 2Co.1.12; 2.17.† 
(AS)

εἱλίσσω, see: ἑλέσσω Transcriber: Is this word in Abbott-Smith?.
(AS)
